name: Blue Ghost Mission 1 landing site (CLPS, Mare Crisium)
note: Firefly's Blue Ghost Mission 1 landed on 2 Mar 2025 near Mons Latreille in Mare Crisium, as located by LRO. Near side, mid-latitude: a normal 14-day lunar day and Earth always up. Terrain from the 1.9 km global map.
source: LROC, Firefly Blue Ghost Landing Region
provenance: Terrain: NASA LOLA LDEM_16 (~1.9 km/px, global). Ephemeris: JPL DE421 via Skyfield, MOON_ME frame. Curvature included, no refraction. Validated against JPL Horizons and NASA LOLA illumination maps.
